profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Full-Stack Development | AI Specialization (Georgia Tech MS CS) 👨‍💻☕🏳️‍🌈
profile.summary:
Senior Software Engineer with 15+ years of experience delivering full-stack solutions across 37 diverse organizations. Expertise in architecting scalable web applications, optimizing data systems, and automating complex business workflows. Proven ability to integrate quickly into cross-functional teams as the technical lead, collaborating with executives, product managers, designers, and engineers to ship products that drive measurable business outcomes. Currently completing a Master's in Computer Science (AI specialization) at Georgia Tech.

Technical Skills:
* Languages: C#, Python, Java, TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6+), PHP, SQL
* Frameworks & Libraries: ASP.NET, MVC, Entity Framework, React.js, Vue.js, Node.js, Drupal, Kendo UI
* Databases: MS SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB
* Cloud & DevOps: AWS (EC2), CI/CD, Docker (familiar), Linux/Ubuntu, Windows Server, IIS, Apache
* Tools & Practices: Git, RESTful APIs, JSON/XML, JIRA, Agile/Scrum, code review, OOP/OOD, design patterns
* Domains: E-commerce, supply chain, OCR, blockchain (Cardano), PCI compliance, WCAG accessibility, EDI

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer / Principal Consultant
positions.description:
Served as a senior engineer embedded within diverse client teams, each with unique tech stacks, domain challenges, and business goals. Technical authority, collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders to deliver end-to-end solutions

Automation & Efficiency
* Cut order processing time 80% with a C# microservice integrating Amazon Seller Central APIs to auto-generate artwork and streamline print queues
* Eliminated mis-shipments for a retailer processing 800+ daily orders via full-stack barcode scanning, verification logic, and USPS API integration
* Automated manufacturing and shipping workflows, saving 10-12 min per order and cutting human error 94%
* Built a Drupal PHP/MySQL plugin with tabular editing and version-controlled documents, saving an architecture firm 5 hrs/week
 
Data-Driven Optimization
* Enabled near-instant price updates for 120,000+ products using BOM metadata and MS SQL stored procedures, protecting margins and inventory accuracy
* Cut a stored procedure runtime from 16 hours to under 3 minutes via temp tables and pre-update validation
* Built a quoting tool for 120K+ custom products, trimming 3-9 hours off the sales cycle; automated marketing emails with availability and profitability checks, saving 2-3 hrs per campaign
 
Platform & Infrastructure
* Architected e-commerce platforms with 250,000+ product catalogs, plus microservices, dashboards, portals, and APIs for orders, inventory, tax, and compliance, built on OOP and event-driven patterns
* Built C# OCR kiosks for a township issuing 50,000 permits/year, backed by a resilient mainframe accepting RESTful XML from multiple locations
* Built a UPS/USPS rate calculator for multi-package expedited orders, protecting margins on mixed-product and free-shipping offers
* Maintained a Cardano block-producing node on AWS EC2 at 99.9% uptime
 
Technical Leadership
* Partnered with executives, PMs, designers, and engineers to deliver on time and budget; led full SDLC from requirements to maintenance
positions.insights: Web Development, User Interface and +37 skills

positions.title: IT Manager / Software Developer
positions.description:
Redesigned e-commerce platforms with a focus on responsive design, security, and performance, achieving a 45% increase in conversion rates. Led cross-functional teams and managed full IT infrastructure.
 
* Led a team of 7 engineers, 3 designers, and 1 system administrator, earning "Employee of the Year" within 18 months
* Increased operational efficiency by 60% through custom software applications and strategic automation
* Deployed e-commerce platforms, enterprise Microsoft software, Dynamics GP ERP, and internal portals
* Managed IT infrastructure availability, performance, scalability, change management, and capacity planning
* Spearheaded integration of payment gateways, third-party APIs, and EDI systems

positions.title: Webmaster
positions.description: Spearheaded the design and implementation of the company’s eCommerce site. Collaborated, designed, developed, tested, maintained, and optimized E-Commerce websites, web portals and windows applications using ASP Visual Basic, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Provided website maintenance and support across Firefox, IE, and Safari browsers. Git version control using Visual Studio and Dreamweaver as an IDE. Performance testing and monitoring website traffic/analytics. Diagnosed and resolved website issues.
